applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters) - Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Complete the process of classifying a borrower as a wilful defaulter within six months of the account being classified as NPA.
answer.action_quote: a bank shall complete the process of classification/ declaring the borrower as a wilful defaulter by following the mechanism set out in Paragraph 5, within six months of the account being classified as NPA

effective_date.quote: The above amendment shall come into force from April 01, 2027.
